title: Build, grow and trade in Cookie Skyblock
summary: A persistent Cookie Orchard island, guided progression, helpers and a safe player market arrive together on Minecraft and the companion app.
body:
- Create a permanent Cookie Orchard in the sky, expand its protected building area and improve a resource generator through five tiers.
- Follow twelve guided quests across three chapters and grow mining, farming, foraging and combat skills.
- Invite trusted players to your co-op and use island roles to keep building and market permissions under control.
- Deposit supported resources from either Minecraft edition, then manage listings and purchases securely from the companion app.
- Market purchases use coins earned through play only. Coins cannot be bought, converted to money or redeemed outside Cookie Build.
- Miner, farmer and lumberjack helpers keep producing for up to twelve hours while you are away.
- Java inventory menus and Bedrock forms share the same gameplay actions and server-side checks.
